locale.name: package.description
locale.en: This package provides the user with an easy interface to schedule, manage and execute crons. Crons are recurring tasks e.g. maintenance tasks or publishing certain pages at a later moment in time.

locale.name: message.cron.admin.info.24h
locale.en:
In the past 24 hours no cronjobs were executed.

It is possible that the cronjobs are not configured properly.


This can lead to important system tasks not being performed and the system no longer running without errors.


Please contact an administrator with this error message!

locale.name: message.cron.admin.info.24h.text
locale.en: Cronjobs have not been executed correctly!

locale.name: message.cron.cli_only
locale.en: This cron can only be executed from the command line.

locale.name: message.ajax.cronservice.general_error
locale.en: Unfortunately, this did not work. Please try again or contact support@pcsg.de!

locale.name: settings.cron.executeOnAdminLogin.description
locale.en:
For more information on running crons automatically, see the wiki:
https://dev.quiqqer.com/quiqqer/package-cron/wikis/administration

locale.name: settings.cron.showAdminMessageIfCronNotRun
locale.en: Show cron notifications when an administrator logs in.

locale.name: settings.cron.showAdminMessageIfCronNotRun.description
locale.en: The administrator receives a message if no crons have run in the last 24 hours.

locale.name: settings.cron.writeCronLog.description
locale.en: Log execution time and length in a daily cron.log

locale.name: settings.cron_lock_time.description
locale.en: Determines the number of seconds the central QUIQQER cron execution (checking and execution of all crons) is locked when the central QUIQQER cron execution is started. This prevents crons from being executed in parallel if necessary. The lock lasts as long as the time specified here or until the central QUIQQER cron execution is finished.

locale.name: settings.cron_lock_timeout_notification.title
locale.en: Notification when the execution lock time is exceeded

locale.name: settings.cron_lock_timeout_notification.description
locale.en: Send e-mail notification to the system administrator if the central QUIQQER cron execution takes longer than the execution lock time.

locale.name: exception.registration.empty.packageDir
locale.en: Could not parse the "package" folder path.

locale.name: cron.cron.cleanupUploads.description
locale.en: Clears the upload folder from files older than one day.

locale.name: cron.cleanup.history.description
locale.en: Deletes old entries from the cron history that are older than a defined number of weeks.

locale.name: cron.cleanup.cache.admin.media.clear.title
locale.en: System Cleanup: Empty Administration's Media Cache

locale.name: cron.cleanup.cache.admin.media.clear.description
locale.en: Cleans the cache of images for the administration. These are for example thumbnails for the administration. The public media cache is not cleared.

locale.name: cron.cleanup.cache.purge.description
locale.en: Removes stale data from the cache while leaving current data intact.

locale.name: cron.calculatePackageFolderSize.description

locale.name: cron.calculateCacheFolderSize.description
locale.en: Calculates the size of the cache-folder and caches it. This value is used by some system functions.

locale.en: Calculates the size of the whole QUIQQER installation folder and caches it. This value is used by some system functions.

locale.name: cron.countAllFilesInInstallation.description
locale.en: Counts the files in the QUIQQER installation folder and caches the result. This value is used by some system functions.

locale.name: cron.calculateVarFolderSize.title

locale.name: cron.calculateVarFolderSize.description
locale.en: Calculates the size of the VAR-folder and caches it. This value is used by some system functions.

locale.name: cron.window.cronservice.content.about.text
locale.en: The QUIQQER cronservice enables systems without native cron functionality to execute the QUIQQER crons anyway. This is realized with an external server on which QUIQQER systems can register themselves. This server will start the scheduled crons of all registered QUIQQER systems regularly.

locale.en: You can check the state of your registration here :

Bear in mind that the email could have been marked as spam.
